kali-server._comment: Kali official MCP Server. Available after `apt install mcp-kali-server`. Can directly invoke arbitrary terminal tools such as nmap/nxc/curl/gobuster.

metasploit-mcp._comment: Metasploit Framework MCP interface. `apt install metasploitmcp`. Supports exploit/payload/session management.

hexstrike._comment: HexStrike AI MCP. `apt install hexstrike-ai`. Automated orchestration of 150+ security tools.

pentestswarm._comment: Pentest Swarm AI. Swarm-intelligence autonomous penetration framework. `go install` or Docker. Supports `--swarm` mode.

anything-analyzer._comment: Browser automation + HTTP capture. Requires cloning first and starting with `pnpm dev`.

idapro._comment: IDA Pro MCP. Requires IDA Pro Linux edition + the ida-pro-mcp plugin. The port may increment up to 13350.

ghidra._comment: Ghidra MCP. `apt install ghidra` + GhidraMCP plugin. Free IDA alternative.
